newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Itau H1 net rises vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Itau H1 net rises vs year ago.

text.p: Banco Itau S.A., Brazil's second-largest private bank, released the following consolidated financial results for the first half of 1997.
Note: The figures are in Brazilian reais.
The company said in a published statement that net profit in the January-June period represented a profitability of 17.5 percent over net worth
Earlier this year, Banco Itau acquired Rio de Janeiro state bank Banco Banerj S.A. in a privatization auction for 178 million reais. It will only be included in the Itau results in the sedcond half.

In May, in a reorganization of the Itau Group, the bank took control of insurance unit Itau Seguros. The unit reported premiums of 819 million reais and reserves of 1.387 billion reais in the first half.
Consolidated assets of Banco Itau reached 37.876 billion reais, up 18.2 percent since December 1996.
